╭─┐help┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮╯│
│        Key:        Description:                                            │─╯
│       +, -, =      Add/Subtract 100ms to/from update timer.                │─╮
│      Up, Down      Select in process list.                                 │%│
│        Enter       Show detailed information for selected process.         │8│
│      Spacebar      Expand/collapse the selected process in tree view.      │0│
│          C         Expand/collapse the selected process' children.         │6│
│   Pg Up, Pg Down   Jump 1 page in process list.                            │5│
│      Home, End     Jump to first or last page in process list.             │9│
│     Left, Right    Select previous/next sorting column.                    │2│
│        b, n        Select previous/next network device.                    │6│
│          i         Toggle disks io mode with big graphs.                   │6│
│          z         Toggle totals reset for current network device          │ │
│          a         Toggle auto scaling for the network graphs.             │ │
│          y         Toggle synced scaling mode for network graphs.          │ │
│        f, /        To enter a process filter. Start with ! for regex.      │ │
│          F         Follow selected process.                                │ │
